tagline: 柯达便携相机，1978 年发布
description: 柯达于1978年推出的便携相机。配备25mm f/8。快门速度1/200 sec for ISO 200 speed film or greater。使用110 (13 mm × 17 mm)。Fixed focus from 5 feet (1.5 meters) to infinity。

specs.对焦: Fixed focus from 5 feet (1.5 meters) to infinity
specs.快门速度: 1/200 sec for ISO 200 speed film or greater
specs.英文简介: The Kodak Ektralite 10 camera was an inexpensive 110-format point and shoot camera produced by Eastman Kodak from 1978 to 1994.
